name: wallstreetsahead-data
description: Fetches the WallStreetsAhead.ai ETF mover reports from Azure Files into the local data folder on request.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: The WallStreetsAhead.ai API gateway address, for example https://api.wallstreetsahead.ai/ClaudeCodePlugin. Leave blank if you entered it in the installer.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your personal WallStreetsAhead.ai API key from the administrator. Leave blank if you entered it in the installer.
